title: SCOPE_DELTA_AUTHORITY_TRANSPORT_V1
description: Immutable authority transport manifest produced by the producer (run_refinement_preflight.py) for a single invocation, binding SCOPE_DELTA_AUTHORITY_EVIDENCE_V1 source identity to a canonical payload digest. Consumed by the router (decide_next_loop_action.py, command_registry.py `decide.run`) and, transitively, by the controlled consumer (run_refinement_preflight.py --consume-authority-transport). #2053.

canonicalization_id.description: #2053 P2 fix-delta (iteration 2): narrowed to a const of the only canonicalization actually implemented by producer/router/consumer (plain json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)). 'rfc8785-jcs' was declared but never dispatched on -- removed until an actual RFC 8785 implementation (with its number/sorting semantics) exists.

payload.description: The SCOPE_DELTA_AUTHORITY_EVIDENCE_V1 (or list thereof) whose canonical bytes are hashed into payload_sha256.
